To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the students in the experimental group (those who learned vocabulary through a contextual approach) outperformed those in the control group (who used the traditional method of learning vocabulary through memorizing) on all three of the variables: gender, socioeconomic status, and grammatical category.
the method of learning, gender and socioeconomic level have a significant impact on the lexical acquisition of students of the Orientation Course in the Spanish as a foreign language classroom.

the students who learned the vocabulary items by means of a method of presentation and practice which included the use of the L1 (Spanish) and a method which did not use the L1 (English) performed equally well on the test.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the lexical acquisition of a group of 100 students of the Orientation Course at the University of Las Palmas de G.C. (Spain) who have been taught Spanish as a foreign language.
the following questions: (1) Is there a significant correlation between the learning method and the lexical acquisition of the students?
the relationship between method and lexical acquisition at three different levels of education.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results of this study show that, as far as vocabulary learning is concerned, the method of teaching is the most important factor.

, in the case of this group of learners, the use of the metods of learning by doing and by listening and reading, and the combination of these methods, have produced the best results, in terms of the number of words acquired and the number of categories learned.

the students of the University Orientation Course, in Las Palmas de Grand Canaria, are not only capable of acquiring the vocabulary of a foreign language, but they can also do it through a communicative methodology, and that this methodology is not only useful to acquire vocabulary but also to acquire grammatical structures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the method of teaching has no effect on the lexical acquisition of university freshmen, that the lexical acquisition is higher in the students with a higher socio-cultural level and that the lexical acquisition does not vary with the sex of the students.
the students who used a communicative method in their Spanish courses were more successful at learning Spanish than those students who used a traditional method of instruction.

the students of the University Preparatory Program, in spite of the fact that their learning is more formal and less spontaneous than that of students at the Basic Spanish Course, show a better acquisition of lexical items, especially in the case of students who have a high level of formal education.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the method of teaching and the level of proficiency in the language of the students are the two variables that have the strongest effect on the lexical development of the students in the three levels of education that we studied.

the students' performance in a test of lexical acquisition is not affected by the type of methodology used in the classroom.
